summary: Frontend-only smoke test of Meta Cloud API channel addition. Verified login → Connections page → Nova Conexão modal with WhatsApp API Oficial (Meta) as first/default channel type, all Meta credential fields (Phone Number ID, Access Token, WABA ID, Verify Token, Catalog ID) plus PIX info box render correctly; switching to Evolution reveals its own fields and hides Meta fields; Chat page loads without errors.

issues: No data-testid attributes on channel type select, credential inputs, or Nova Conexão button — makes automated testing brittle (tests currently rely on text/CSS selectors).
Title uses garbled dash character in `Conectar â€” ${qrModal.name}` (mojibake, should be em-dash).

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to Connections page interactive elements (Nova Conexão button, tipo select, phoneNumberId/accessToken/wabaId/verifyToken/catalogId inputs, Cancelar/Salvar buttons).
Fix mojibake in QR modal title (Conectar â€” ...) — replace with proper em-dash.
critical_code_review_comments: Connections.tsx keeps demo-mode timeouts in pollRef but clears with clearInterval; use appropriate cleanup for setTimeout too (currently pollRef.current = setTimeout as any, cleared via clearInterval).
Access Token is rendered with type=password (good) but stored in localStorage in plain text via channels list — flag for security review.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core Meta Cloud API integration in the Connections modal is working end-to-end at the UI level. Default channel type is whatsapp_official; Meta credential form + PIX info box render; switching to whatsapp_evolution swaps to Evolution creds. Chat page loads without runtime errors. Backend endpoints /api/meta/* were NOT tested (frontend-only scope).
